newsitem.title: USA: American Biogenetic drug succeeds in test.
newsitem.headline: American Biogenetic drug succeeds in test.

text.p: American Biogenetic Sciences Inc said Monday one of its drugs appeared to be at least three times more sensitive than other commercial drugs in helping doctors diagnose heart attacks.

The company said the drug, called TpP (thrombus precursor protein), helped detect blood clots faster than other biochemical markers in clinical tests conducted at Brown University's School of Medicine.
The drug has already been cleared by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, it said.
The company also said the peak plasma concentration of the drug preceded those of other heart attack markers by two to four hours in patients with acute myocardial infarction.
